id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description: The specification used for retrieving data displayed by the grid.

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

totalDataCount.description: The spec used for retrieving the total data count, will be used for exporting and pagination.

dataCollectionCount.description: Holds the total count of the data.

dataCollection.description: Holds the data to display in the grid.

detailComponentId.description: When a component is provided, it is shown as detail when a row is expanded.

detailComponentFilterable.description: Whether we should apply filter from the filter panel to the detailComponent.

expandedItems.description:
A mapping to keep track of which item details to expand.
Key is item id, value is boolean.

map<string, boolean> doesn't play well with Immutable.js

checkboxes.description: Specifies whether checkboxes will be prepended to each row in the grid.

scrollbarAlwaysVisible.description: Whether the scrollbar should be visible on scroll or all the time

checkboxesShowSelectAllBanner.description: Specifies whether select all action will be enabled when a checkboxes are present in a grid.

rowStyle.description:
Specifies the row style of the grid.

'LINE_DIVISIONS' would add lines between each row,
'FREE_FORM' would add no lines between any row or column, and
'GRID_LINES' would add lines between each row and between each column.

zebraStripes.description: Specifies whether the grid's rows will have alternating background colors.

rowDensity.description: Specifies the visible density of the grid rows.

resizableColumns.description: Specifies whether to allow the user to resize columns in the grid display.

reorderableColumns.description:
Specifies whether to allow the user to reorder columns in the grid display.
NOTE: even if this is true, columns with {@link UiSdlDataGridDataSpecColumnFieldSetting#sticky} as true will not be re-orderable

removableRows.description: Specifies whether to allow the user to add and remove individual grid rows in order to change the underlying data.

confirmBeforeRowDelete.description:
Whether to show a confirmation modal when deleting a row.
This only takes effect if {@link #removableRows} is `true`.

When set to true, the grid dispatches a `ROW_ACTION_CLICK_DELETE_WITH_CONFIRMATION` action
instead of the standard `ROW_ACTION_CLICK_DELETE` action. This allows the developer to
implement a custom confirmation modal before the row is deleted.

The `ROW_ACTION_CLICK_DELETE_WITH_CONFIRMATION` action is handled by {@link #pendingRowDeletionIdUpdateEffect}, which updates {@link #pendingRowDeletionId}.

pendingRowDeletionId.description: Saves the rows id for deletion, when there is a confirmation modal before deletion.

selectedItemIds.description:
`id`s of items that are currently selected in a checklist grid.
Applicable if and only if {@link grid#checkBoxes} is `true`.

sortColumn.description:
Internal state field to capture the current sort column and sort order. This field
should not be configured directly. For configuring a column to be used as the data grid's
default sort order (i.e. on initial render), use
{@link UiSdlBaseDataGridDataSpecColumnFieldSetting#defaultSortField} instead.

isEditing.description: Whether the grid is in editable mode (a field is actively being edited).

editItemId.description:
The `id` of the item that is being edited.
Applicable if and only if one of the {@link UiSdlDataGridDataSpecColumnFieldSetting#editable} is true.

editItemField.description:
The `field` of the item that is being edited.
Applicable if and only if one of the {@link UiSdlDataGridDataSpecColumnFieldSetting#editable} is true.

editChanges.description: The changes that are made to the grid. This key is `id`; value is an array of fields modified.

editErrors.description: The upserting editErrors from {@link #editChanges}. This key is `id`; value is a map of field to error message.

rowActions.description: The set of row-specific actions to be rendered in each row.

tableActionsCollapseThreshold.description:
The number of table actions to display on the grid header.  If there are more, an additional table action
icon is displayed, and the extra actions are displayed under a dropdown triggered by clicking the additional
table action.

Table actions that are configured outside of the {@link #tableActions} field (such as adding new rows,
removing columns, or exporting) do not count towards this limit.  The additional table action itself
does count towards the limit.  Examples:

- If tableActionsCollapseThreshold is set to 2 and there are two actions, both of them are shown on the
  grid header, and there is no additional actions icon.
- If tableActionsCollapseThreshold is set to 2 and there are three actions - "A", "B", and "C" - the
  grid header will show action "A" and the additional actions icon.  Clicking the additional actions icon
  will show a dropdown containing actions "B" and "C".

tableActions.description:
The set of actions that don't depend on rows, e.g., export, refresh. A toggleable group of actions can also be
specified. When considering the `tableActionsCollapseThreshold`, consider the table actions to be flattened.
Listen to triggers of the table actions through `TABLE_ACTION_CLICK_${actionSuffix}`. Actions specified in a
UiSdlBaseDataGridSelectableTableAction will only be triggered when it enters a "selected" state.

multipleRowActions.description:
The set of actions that could apply to one or more rows.

Those actions will be visible only if one or more rows are selected.

insertableRows.description:
Whether grid allows inserting rows. If this field's value is `false` in metadata, grid does not allow new row insertion.
If this field's value is not set, then we use {@link UiSdlDataGrid#removableRows} to decide whether to allow new row insertion.

emptyState.description:
The component that handles the empty state.
It will appear if the grid has no data.

selectedGridItems.description: The currently selected items in the grid. See {@link UiSdlSelectedGridItemConfig} for the selectable item types.

selectableRows.description:
Whether or not rows without a checkbox are selectable on row click. Will only be respected if {@link #checkboxes}
is false.

selectableColumns.description: Whether or not columns are selectable on header click.

showCheckboxActionButtons.description: Whether to show the action button in the grid header (checkboxes enabled).

showRowActionsOnIdle.description:
Whether to show row actions on grid rows on idle. If false, row actions will show on hover.
If true:
1. Single action: Display a visible icon for the specific action.
2. Two or more actions: Display the "…" (ellipsis) icon and allow users to view the available actions in a menu.

checkboxPrimaryActionButtonText.description: Whether to show the action button in the grid header (checkboxes enabled).

checkboxSecondaryActionButtonText.description: Whether to show the action button in the grid header (checkboxes enabled).

showSaveCancelButton.description:
Whether to show the save cancel button in the grid header. If set to true, this will force the save/cancel buttons
to be shown, regardless of whether any grid cells have been edited.

hideSaveCancelButtonOnEdit.description:
Whether to hide the save/cancel buttons when the grid is editable, and a cell has been edited.
This should be set to true if custom table actions are being used to save/cancel changes.

saveChangesButtonText.description: Enabled to pass new label for save button.

caseSensitive.description: Whether the filter string needs to take case-sensitivity into account.

filterComparator.description: The comparator to use when generating the filter expression with the new search query.

isLoading.description:
Whether the search is loading or not.
This is an internal state, developers should not touch it manually.

replaceArgument.description:
The argument in the data source API to replace with the new (and maybe transformed) search query string.
By default, the argument is `spec`, assuming it is a fetch call with a filter spec.

dataSourceFieldMaps.description:
A private cache of field {@link ValueType} maps for each datasource associated with this component. Use
{@link getFieldMapForDatasource} as an interface with this field; do not use 'dataSourceFieldMaps' directly.

activeFilters.description:
A mapping of componentId to the filter string generated by that component, so that all strings can be combined
when generating the filter string.
For example, `{ SDL.ExampleGrid: 'id == "SomeID"', SDL.ExampleFilterPanel: 'name == "SomeName"' }` would be
combined to form the filter string `'( id == "SomeID" ) && ( name == "SomeName" )'`.

fuzzyCount.description:
Determines whether to display the final count of items in the grid returned from fetchCount
When this is set to true, network request to fetchCount is not made. If table is {@link exportable}
with `fuzzyCount === true`, and displaying export warning modal always is not desired,
{@link disableExportWarningModal} can be set to true

disableExportWarningModal.description:
If set to `true`, the export warning modal will never be displayed. Can be used together with
{@link fuzzyCount} to disable always displaying the export warning modal on export request

paginationConfig.description: Pagination configuration options for the data grid.

numberFormatSpec.description:
Number formatting spec to be used in the grid.
Individual columns can override this with {@link UiSdlDataGridDataSpecColumnFieldSetting#format}.

fixedRows.description: Determines whether to display all rows in UI (pagination must be false).

defaultPageSize.description:
The default page size configuration.
This must be same as {@link UiSdlDataGridPaginationConfig#pageSize}.

filterBar.description: Specifies whether to render the filter bar subcomponent.

removableColumns.description: Specifies whether to allow the user to remove and re-add columns in the grid display.

paginationDataSkipSize.description: Defines the number of records that will be skipped by the pager.

dataOffset.description:
Used in data grid infinite mode. To enable infinite scroll mode, do not set paginationConfig.
This value represents the index of the top value in the grid in the collection.
This value changes as user scrolls up and down.

rowActionAlignment.description: The alignment of the row actions in the {@link UiSdlDataGrid}.

fullWidthNestedComponent.description: Displays the nested/detail component in full width of the grid.

exportable.description: Whether grid allows exporting data from the grid to excel.

rowActionsCollapseThreshold.description: Stores threshold for the row actions to collapse into a modal

exportData.description:
The spec used for retrieving data used for export, will be exact same as dataSpec.
Developer should not override this field.
Leverage customExport and loadCustomExportDataAction for exporting with an API call.

customExport.description: Should be set to true when using a custom export so the regular export flow will not occur.

headerMaxLinesWhenTruncated.description:
When the content of the header cell is larger than the width of the cell,
the content will be wrapped to this number of lines and then truncate the rest.
The content will be accessible in a tooltip by hovering over the cell.

maxLinesWhenTruncated.description:
When the content of the cell is larger than the width of the cell,
the content will be wrapped to this number of lines and then truncate the rest.
The content will be accessible in a tooltip by hovering over the cell.

exportDataCollection.description: Holds the data to be exported.

userHasAcknowledgedExportWarning.description:
A flag which captures the state of whether or not the user has accepted the warning from the
modal when attempting to export a grid with more than {@link UiSdlDataGrid#exportWarningRecordThreshold} rows.

columnsOrder.description:
A map that stores the order of columns from left to right.
The keys are column identifiers (strings) and the values are their respective positions (integers).

tableActionsAlwaysVisible.description: A flag that makes the {@link tableActions} always visible even if {@link multipleRowActions} is displayed.

title: A UI component type that displays data in a grid-like table.
name: UiSdlDataGrid
